title: Generic finite local constancy of module subsheaves
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $\Lambda$ a Noetherian commutative ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], and $\varphi:F\to G$ a monomorphism of sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules on the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Assume $G$ is constructible [def-constructible-constructible]. There exists an open subset $U\subseteq X$ dense in $X$ such that the restriction of $F$ to $U$ is finite locally constant [def-constructible-finite-locally-constant], where finite means finitely generated module stalks. No constructibility conclusion is asserted on $X\setminus U$.

source.place: Tag 09BH, Proposition 59.74.1 (3), proof of (3), generic-neighbourhood argument

proof.text: Use generic constancy of G. At each of the finitely many irreducible component generic points, choose an etale trivialization and remove the other components. The target is constant with value a finitely generated module M on an irreducible neighbourhood.

The geometric generic stalk identifies F with a submodule N of M. N has finitely many generators over the Noetherian ring. Choose representatives on a common pointed etale neighbourhood and shrink so their images are the fixed constant generators.

The two pullbacks of each representative agree because their images are constant and the inclusion is monic. The sheaf axiom descends them over the open image. Thus the constant N is contained in F. The quotient F/N is a subsheaf of constant M/N with zero generic stalk, hence zero: any nonzero constant germ on a nonempty etale neighbourhood of an irreducible scheme persists at a generic point. These local trivializations descend to finite local constancy about each component generic point. Take disjoint component opens by removing the other components; their finite union is dense. This is the generic-neighbourhood argument of Stacks 09BH (3), without the subsequent Noetherian induction.

    [IsNoetherianRing Λ]
    {F G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)}
    (φ : F ⟶ G) [Mono φ] [IsConstructibleSheaf G] :
    ∃ U : X.Opens, Dense (U : Set X) ∧
      IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf ((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) U.ι).obj F)
